newline_pins.search: every .ts, .tsx, .mjs, .cjs and .js file under portal/src/pages/InvestorReporting/__tests__ (448 files; 269 of them read file text or run git). Two instruments, each a short python script run from the scratchpad: (1) every regex literal whose body holds a bare LF escape not preceded by an optional CR (18 hits; the same scan on the pre-fix iv-e-116 blob found its 2 anchors, so it can fire); (2) every includes/indexOf/lastIndexOf/startsWith/endsWith/toContain/toMatch/replace call whose first string argument holds an LF escape (5 hits). Each of the 23 hits was read in context.

list.why: strips the import from PrintEntry.tsx's text for the CONTROL arm; the old regex ended on a bare LF directly after a literal and matched nothing on CRLF text (bun -e: old on CRLF false, new on CRLF true, new on LF true)

newline_pins.read_and_left: The other 22 of the 23 hits were read in context and tolerate CRLF: a lazy [\s\S]*? body or a line start with the LF in front of the literal (iv-e-117:96, iv-e-118:126, iv-e-17:42, iv-e-26:105, iv-e-31:121, fe-s-47:428, iv-e-19:42, fe-s-35:249); a negated [^LF] tail that is trimmed or only searched (iv-e-148:93, iv-e-31:126, iv-e-48:102, path-a-skip:43, fe-s-25 absent-vs-null:172, fe-s-25 source-age-field:116, fe-s-34:82, fe-s-4:282, fe-s-6:38); and generators or probes (fe-s-50:44 and fe-s-41:629 turn LF into CRLF on purpose, fe-s-46:630 edits text the test generates itself with LF, iv-e-37:206 and gen-wire:356 probe for any LF). iv-e-116 was fixed earlier (a3f4b6dc) and is not counted.
